items.title: Zacks.com featured highlights include Cinemark, ConocoPhillips, Pebblebrook Hotel Trust and Chord Energy
items.summary: Zacks highlights four stocks trading near 52-week highs that are expected to maintain momentum: Cinemark benefits from a content-heavy holiday slate and stronger balance sheet; ConocoPhillips focuses on free cash flow growth and capital returns; Pebblebrook Hotel Trust raised 2026 outlook with improved balance sheet metrics; Chord Energy is streamlining operations through asset sales and maintaining buyback programs.

items.title: IonQ vs. SoundHound AI: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares two emerging technology stocks: IonQ, a quantum computing leader with 201.9% revenue growth but significant losses, and SoundHound AI, a voice technology company with 99.4% revenue growth and a clearer path to profitability. While both are high-growth plays on AI trends, the author recommends SoundHound AI for 2027 due to the larger addressable market for AI ($1.9 trillion by 2032) versus quantum computing ($17.8 billion by 2034), and SoundHound's more mainstream commercial applications.

items.title: Why McDonald's Stock Popped Today
items.summary: McDonald's stock surged 6.53% after Q3 earnings beat expectations, with adjusted EPS of $3.57 versus Wall Street estimates of $3.38. The company's value-focused menu strategy is attracting cost-conscious consumers, with U.S. comparable sales turning positive in September. McDonald's also raised its dividend by 4% to $1.93 per share, marking the 50th consecutive year of dividend increases.

items.title: Webull (BULL) Faces Securities Class Action Amid House Committee Findings: “Profound Gap” Between Company Statements and Operational Reality – HBSS
items.summary: Webull Corporation faces a federal securities class action lawsuit alleging misrepresentations about its business structure and China operations. A House Select Committee report confirmed that Webull's data practices expose U.S. investors to PRC surveillance risks, its governance is dominated by PRC-linked control, and its subsidiary accepted conditional CCP government funding. The stock fell approximately 19% to $5.89 per share following the committee's findings. The class period runs from April 26, 2025 to October 6, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 7, 2026.

items.title: Kraft Heinz: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Kraft Heinz announced the divestiture of its North American coffee business to One Rock while retaining a 30% stake, allowing the company to focus capital on higher-growth core brands. The company is deploying $700 million in brand and marketing investments with data-driven adjustments to pricing strategies. Management expects input cost inflation slightly above 5% next year and plans to rely on productivity gains before implementing targeted price increases, though price hikes appear inevitable in 2027.

items.title: ASML vs. Marvell Technology: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Buy Going into 2027?
items.summary: The article compares ASML and Marvell Technology as AI investment opportunities. ASML holds a monopoly on EUV lithography machines essential for advanced chip manufacturing, with strong financials (36.7B revenue, 29.4% net margin). Marvell specializes in AI data infrastructure with impressive 42% YoY growth and ambitious $70-90B revenue targets by 2031. Despite ASML's lower valuation metrics, the author recommends Marvell due to its higher growth trajectory and strategic acquisition of Lumentum to enhance optical connectivity capabilities.

items.title: Datadog: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Datadog reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.2 billion with 35% year-over-year growth. Key highlights include accelerating non-AI customer revenue growth for five consecutive quarters in the high-20s percent, infrastructure monitoring suite exceeding $2 billion in annual recurring revenue, and new customers accounting for 30% of revenue growth. The company serves all 15 top AI leaders and over 850 AI customers, positioning it well for long-term enterprise spending.

items.title: Why Intuit Stock Jumped 24% in October
items.summary: Intuit stock surged 24% in October following the company's acquisition of Sequence, an AI-native revenue management platform, and the introduction of new AI features across its product suite. Despite the recovery, the stock remains down 48% year-to-date due to concerns about AI disruption. The company's moves signal efforts to regain traction in the AI era, though earnings growth remains challenged.

items.title: FLNC IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Fluence Energy, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – FLNC
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces securities class action lawsuits against Fluence Energy, Inc. (FLNC) and AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS). The FLNC lawsuit alleges the company made false statements regarding its ability to deliver backlog and meet fiscal 2026 guidance due to incomplete manufacturing facilities and unresolved production problems. Investors with losses exceeding $100K are encouraged to join before the November 30, 2026 deadline for FLNC and November 13 deadline for ASTS.

items.title: ASTS DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important November 13 Deadline in Securities Class Action - ASTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding capital requirements, liquidity position, competitive standing in the satellite D2C market, and user adoption rates. Investors who purchased ASTS securities between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 13, 2026.

items.title: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL SECURITIES LAW FIRM, Reminds AppLovin Corporation (NASDAQ: APP) Investors of Class Action and November 16, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
items.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating AppLovin Corporation for alleged securities law violations, claiming the company misled investors about the readiness and performance of its AI models and self-service ad tools. AppLovin's stock plummeted 19.6% on August 6, 2026, after the company reported missed revenue estimates and acknowledged significant developmental delays in its generative AI video tools. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

items.title: Why Alphabet Stock Popped on Wednesday
items.summary: Alphabet stock surged 3.2% following Democratic election victories that prioritize stricter data center regulation. The potential moratorium on data center construction in key states like Texas, Ohio, Georgia, and Arizona could slow Alphabet's capital expenditure spending, boost free cash flow, and benefit the company's competitive position as an established hyperscaler. Trading at 15x earnings, the stock is viewed as a compelling opportunity.

items.title: Figma, Inc. (FIG) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Figma reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.10 per share, doubling consensus estimates of $0.05, with revenues of $391.42 million exceeding expectations by 4.14%. Despite strong earnings performance and a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, the stock has declined 43.7% year-to-date compared to the S&P 500's 10.6% gain. The company's future performance will depend on management guidance and earnings estimate revisions.

items.title: BAC Subject to Increasing Scrutiny: Senator Warren Reportedly Calling For DOJ Criminal Probe Over Violations of Anti-Money Laundering, Sanctions Laws; Securities Class Action Filed -- HBSS
items.summary: Bank of America faces a securities class action lawsuit and calls for a DOJ criminal investigation by Senator Elizabeth Warren following the bank's admission of willful violations of federal anti-money laundering laws. The Treasury Department, FinCEN, and OCC announced enforcement actions requiring BAC to pay over $1.2 billion in penalties for BSA/AML failures and unreported suspicious transactions exceeding $5 billion. The stock declined 4.8% following the disclosure, and investors who suffered losses during the class period (August 1, 2025 – October 13, 2026) are urged to participate in the litigation.

items.title: CenterPoint Energy: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: CenterPoint Energy increased its 10-year capital plan by $4 billion to support rapid industrial expansion in Greater Houston. The company expects over 14% annual rate base growth through 2030, with efficient financing that limits new equity issuance to $1.6 billion for $4 billion in investments, protecting existing shareholders from dilution.

items.title: Brown & Brown: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Brown & Brown raised its 2026 Accession acquisition synergy target to $50 million, exceeding initial expectations. The company deployed AI tools to over 6,000 employees with 90% active usage, accelerating broker workflows. However, admitted carriers expanding into specialty lines create near-term organic revenue headwinds. Management expects stable market conditions ahead with AI deployments supporting long-term growth.

items.title: AppLovin Turns 81% of New Sales Into Profit: Rapid Earnings Reaction
items.summary: AppLovin reported strong Q3 2026 results with 55% revenue growth to $2.18 billion and 72% net income growth to $1.44 billion. The ad platform converted 81% of new revenue into operating income despite doubling research spending. However, free cash flow growth lagged earnings growth due to higher tax payments. Q4 guidance projects continued momentum with steady margins.

items.title: Eversource Energy (ES) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Lag Estimates
items.summary: Eversource Energy reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.92 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $0.97 and falling from $1.19 a year ago. Revenues of $2.98 billion also missed expectations by 12.73%. The company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revisions, and has underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date with a 2.5% gain versus the market's 10.6%.

items.title: Amcor (AMCR) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: Amcor reported quarterly earnings of $0.95 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $0.96, though it exceeded revenue expectations at $6.13 billion versus the estimate of $5.83 billion. The company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revisions, with the stock expected to underperform the market. The Containers - Paper and Packaging industry ranks in the bottom 16% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Motorola Solutions (MSI) Tops Q3 EPS by 27c; raises guidance - StreetInsider
items.summary: Motorola Solutions (MSI) Tops Q3 EPS by 27c; raises guidance    StreetInsider

items.title: Top Research Reports for Microsoft, SpaceX & Marvell
items.summary: Zacks Research Daily features analysis of 16 major stocks on November 4, 2026. Microsoft shows strong Azure growth and AI monetization but faces capital expenditure pressures. SpaceX demonstrates long-term potential through Starlink and Super Intelligence but carries execution risks. Marvell benefits from AI infrastructure demand with record data center revenues. Additional coverage includes analysis of companies like Comfort Systems, Celestica, and TechnipFMC, with mixed outlooks across various sectors.

items.title: Raffterty Domnick Cunningham & Yaffa Responds to Historic $7.35 Billion 3M Settlement Over PFAS Exposure and Personal Injury Claims
items.summary: 3M Company has agreed to a landmark $7.35 billion settlement to resolve personal injury claims related to PFAS ('forever chemicals') exposure, potentially compensating 115,000 to 120,000 plaintiffs. The settlement addresses approximately 99% of existing PFAS-related personal injury claims, with payments to be made over nine years. The litigation centered on aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) used at airports and military installations, with plaintiffs alleging exposure caused serious illnesses including kidney and testicular cancers.

items.title: Roper Technologies increases dividend 10% - its 34th consecutive annual dividend increase
items.summary: Roper Technologies declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.00 per share, representing a 10% increase over 2026 quarterly dividends. This marks the company's 34th consecutive year of dividend increases, demonstrating its commitment to returning capital to shareholders while maintaining its track record of compounding cash flow and shareholder value.

items.title: INVESTOR NOTICE: Everest Group, Ltd. Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before December 28, 2026 Deadline, RGRD Law Announces - EG
items.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announces a class action lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for alleged securities fraud. The lawsuit claims the company made false statements about its casualty risk exposure, inadequate pricing, and insufficient reserves that overstated earnings. Investors who purchased EG stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025 can seek appointment as lead plaintiff before the December 28, 2026 deadline.

items.title: Kaplan Fox Urges Investors of Bank of America Corporation (NYSE: BAC) with Significant Losses to Seek a Leadership Role Before December 15, 2026
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America on behalf of investors who purchased stock between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026. The lawsuit follows the U.S. Department of the Treasury's announcement of over $1.2 billion in penalties and settlements against Bank of America's subsidiary for violations of Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering laws, including failure to detect and report over $5 billion in suspicious activity. The regulatory charges reduced the company's Q3 2026 diluted earnings per share by $0.17, and the stock fell 4.8% following the disclosure.

items.title: United Rentals' Specialty Revenue Surges 35%: What Comes Next?
items.summary: United Rentals (URI) delivered robust Q3 2026 results with Specialty Rentals revenue surging 34.7% to $1.70B and gross margins expanding 250 basis points. The company raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $18-$18.2B and added 12 Specialty locations, though rising equipment costs and labor inflation pose profitability risks. URI faces competition from Herc Holdings and WillScot in the specialized rental market.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Bank of America Corporation (NYSE: BAC) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation alleging the bank made false and misleading statements regarding its Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering compliance program. The complaint claims BAC failed to properly monitor trillions in transactions, missed or delayed suspicious activity reports, and concealed the scope of compliance failures and associated regulatory penalties. Investors who purchased BAC securities between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 15, 2026.

items.title: Is Broadcom Stock a Buy Now?
items.summary: Broadcom exceeded its AI semiconductor revenue target with $16.7 billion in Q3 (beating the $16 billion target) and guided to $21.7 billion for Q4, representing 236% year-over-year growth. Despite strong business results, the stock has declined 31% from its peak and 4% year-to-date. The author argues the stock's valuation at 28.3x forward earnings is justified by the company's exceptional performance and represents an attractive buying opportunity, though risks remain from potential AI spending slowdowns.

items.title: Cencora Q4 Earnings & Revenues Beat on Specialty Growth, Margins Expand
items.summary: Cencora reported Q4 fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS of $4.66, beating estimates by 2.2%, with revenues rising 5.5% to $88.35B. Growth was driven by specialty pharmaceutical volumes, GLP-1 drug demand, and the OneOncology acquisition. The company projects fiscal 2027 EPS of $19.40-$19.75 (8-10% growth), announced a specialty-focused organizational restructure, and raised its quarterly dividend by 10%.

items.title: IREN to Report Q1 Earnings: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: IREN Limited is set to report Q1 fiscal 2027 results on November 5, with consensus estimates pointing to an 8.46% revenue decline to $219.95 million and a wider loss of 49 cents per share. While AI cloud growth from Microsoft's Horizon 1 deployment may provide revenue support, declining bitcoin mining revenues and projected $40-50 million sequential increase in operating expenses are expected to pressure margins and profitability. The stock has fallen 43.7% year-to-date, trading at a lower valuation multiple than peers.

items.title: Home Depot's Margin Outlook Faces Inflationary Headwinds
items.summary: Home Depot's Q2 gross margin expanded 25 bps to 33.7%, boosted by $685M in tariff refunds, but underlying profitability faces headwinds from rising fuel, energy, and input costs, plus acquisition-related mix pressures totaling 120 bps. Management expects these cost increases to offset tariff benefits throughout fiscal 2026, with peers Lowe's and Williams-Sonoma experiencing similar margin compression from inflationary pressures.

items.title: Grainger Beats Earnings Estimates in Q3, Hikes '26 Guidance
items.summary: W.W. Grainger (GWW) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $12.54, up 22.8% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates. The company raised its 2026 sales guidance to $19.8-$20B and adjusted earnings guidance to $47.00-$48.00 per share, driven by strong demand across both operating segments and improved operating margins.

items.title: Can PepsiCo's Snack Pricing Strategy Drive Volume Growth?
items.summary: PepsiCo is boosting snack volumes through pricing and affordability initiatives, with portion-control multipacks generating over $3.5B annually. While Q3 2026 showed improved volume trends and household penetration, the snack segment's core operating margin contracted 280 basis points due to affordability investments and higher advertising costs. The company plans structural cost reductions to fund future growth, but margin pressures remain a challenge.

items.title: KLAC Q1 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and 2027 Growth Outlook
items.summary: KLA Corporation reported strong Q1 fiscal 2027 results with revenues of $4.14 billion and raised its wafer fabrication equipment market outlook to mid-$150 billion for 2026 and exceeding $200 billion for 2027. The company expects advanced packaging revenue to reach $1.1 billion in 2026 with 70%+ growth, driven by AI infrastructure investments and leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing. KLA projects Q2 revenues of $4.7 billion and targets 63%-64% gross margins by late 2027, though elevated memory component costs remain a near-term headwind.

items.title: IFF Earnings Beat Estimates in Q3 on Taste & Scent Strength
items.summary: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) beat Q3 earnings expectations with adjusted EPS of 83 cents and sales of $1.94B, up 3.9% year-over-year. The company raised its 2026 sales guidance to $7.5-$7.6B and EBITDA guidance to $1.55-$1.60B, driven by strong performance in Taste and Scent segments. The company continues its portfolio transformation following the sale of its Food Ingredients business to CVC Capital Partners.

items.title: FIS Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Banking Strength
items.summary: Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of $1.61 per share and revenues of $3.45 billion, both meeting or exceeding expectations. However, the company cut its full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $5.82-$5.89 from $6.15-$6.24, citing client-led banking conversion delays, consolidation impacts, and increased technology and security spending. Banking Solutions revenues surged 41% year-over-year, while adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 111 basis points to 42.9%.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm.
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) alleging that the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts during the period of June 29, 2026 to September 1, 2026. The complaint alleges undisclosed supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, a false Claims Act investigation related to cybersecurity compliance on government contracts, and that positive statements about the company lacked reasonable basis. Investors who purchased securities during the class period may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 23, 2026.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements about its capital requirements, liquidity position, competitive standing in the satellite direct-to-cell market, and user adoption rates in the US and Japan during the period from March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026.

items.title: Does BRK.B's Bending Spoons Investment Signal Digital Growth Focus?
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has invested an additional $330 million in Bending Spoons, raising its ownership stake to approximately 4%. This follows an initial $600 million investment during the company's July 2026 IPO. Bending Spoons operates an acquisition-focused business model, acquiring digital businesses and optimizing their operations. The investment reflects Berkshire's confidence in the company's long-term growth potential and its strategy to expand technology exposure.

items.title: SWK's Q3 Earnings Surge on Margin Expansion, 2026 Outlook Raised
items.summary: Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) reported Q3 adjusted earnings of $2.31 per share, up 61.5% year-over-year, driven by strong Tools & Outdoor segment performance and tariff refunds. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.95-$6.25 and free cash flow forecast to $1.0-$1.2 billion. However, the Engineered Fastening segment faced headwinds with a 21% revenue decline due to the CAM divestiture and weaker automotive demand.

items.title: WMB Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates Amid Higher Costs, Revenues Beat
items.summary: Williams Companies (WMB) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of 54 cents, missing estimates by 1.82%, though revenues beat expectations by 1.19%. The company's $5.5B Momentum Midstream acquisition expanded capacity significantly, with management targeting 11% adjusted EBITDA annual growth through 2030. However, total costs rose 15%, pressuring operating margins despite a 6.2% increase in adjusted EBITDA.

items.title: MPC Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) delivered exceptional Q3 2026 results with adjusted EPS of $26.93, up 794.7% year-over-year, driven by refining margins jumping to $45.70/barrel from $17.60. Revenue surged 57.6% to $56.49 billion, while the renewable diesel segment turned profitable with $254M EBITDA. The company returned $3.3 billion to shareholders and announced an $8.1 billion share repurchase capacity. Peer refiners Valero Energy and Phillips 66 also reported strong earnings driven by favorable refining margins.

items.title: McDonald's Q3 Earnings Beat on Franchised Margins, Revenues Miss
items.summary: McDonald's reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $3.57, up 11% and beating estimates, but revenues of $7.16B missed forecasts. Global comparable sales grew 1.5% with international strength offsetting a 0.2% U.S. decline. Franchised restaurant margins increased 3% to $3.8B. The company maintains 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $3.7B. Other restaurant chains showed mixed results: Chipotle missed earnings but beat revenue, Starbucks beat earnings with strong comps, and Domino's beat both metrics.

items.title: Are You Looking for a Top Momentum Pick? Why Entergy (ETR) is a Great Choice
items.summary: Entergy (ETR) is highlighted as a momentum pick with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating and Momentum Style Score of B. The utility company has outperformed its industry over multiple timeframes, with shares up 2.58% weekly and 13.19% annually. Recent earnings estimate revisions have been positive, with 4 upward revisions and none downward over the past two months, supporting the bullish outlook.

items.title: Are You Looking for a Top Momentum Pick? Why Marriott International (MAR) is a Great Choice
items.summary: Marriott International (MAR) is highlighted as a strong momentum pick with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating and Momentum Style Score of A. The stock has outperformed its industry and the broader market, gaining 52.95% over the past year compared to the S&P 500's 11.59%. Recent earnings estimate revisions have been positive, with 5 upward revisions in the past two months, supporting the bullish outlook.

items.title: Booking Holdings Q3 Earnings Beat on Travel Growth, Revenues Miss
items.summary: Booking Holdings reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $4.66, beating estimates by 4.02% with 17% year-over-year growth, driven by travel demand and cost discipline. However, revenues of $8.89 billion missed consensus by 7.01% and declined 1.3% YoY due to FTC-related reductions. Room nights grew 6.7% to 345 million while gross bookings rose 9.6% to $54.46 billion. The company projects slower Q4 growth with room nights expected to increase only 1-3%, citing softer international travel and regional disruptions.

items.title: Are These 5 Utility Stocks Set to Surpass Q3 Earnings Estimates?
items.summary: Five utility companies report Q3 2026 earnings on November 5, with the sector expected to see 8.3% earnings growth and 5.5% revenue growth driven by rising electricity demand from AI data centers, warmer temperatures, and manufacturing reshoring. Evergy is the only company predicted to beat earnings estimates, while Ameren, DTE Energy, Sempra, and Consolidated Edison are not expected to conclusively beat estimates.

items.title: REGN vs. ILMN: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
items.summary: A comparison of Regeneron (REGN) and Illumina (ILMN) in the biomedical and genetics sector reveals that Regeneron presents a better value opportunity. REGN has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with improving earnings outlook, a forward P/E of 15.74, and a Value grade of B. ILMN has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) with a forward P/E of 44.00 and a Value grade of D, making it significantly more expensive on multiple valuation metrics.

items.title: Western Digital's Q1 Beat and Q2 Outlook Signal More Margin Upside
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) delivered impressive Q1 fiscal 2027 results with 55% revenue growth to $4.38 billion and 161% earnings growth, driven by strong pricing power and higher-capacity drives. The company projects Q2 revenues of $5.1 billion with gross margins of 60-61%, supported by ePMR and HAMR technology transitions. However, valuation concerns persist with a forward P/E of 11.5x above industry averages.

items.title: Is WDC a Buy as Earnings Surge but Valuation and Execution Risks Rise?
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) reported strong Q1 FY2027 results with 55% revenue growth and 161% EPS surge, with Q2 guidance showing continued momentum. However, the stock trades at a 11.5X forward P/E premium to its sub-industry and historical median, raising concerns about valuation sustainability. Execution risks remain around the HAMR technology transition and product ramp timelines.

items.title: ANET Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong AI and Enterprise Demand
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) delivered impressive Q3 2026 results with earnings up 55.8% to $1.2 per share and revenues surging 58.5% to $3.66 billion, driven by robust AI networking demand and enterprise expansion. The company raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $13.3 billion and projects 38-40% growth in 2027, with AI fabrics revenues expected to double to $7 billion.

items.title: KHC Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Emerging Markets Sales Rise
items.summary: Kraft Heinz reported Q3 2026 earnings of 53 cents per share and sales of $6.12 billion, beating consensus estimates despite declining year-over-year. North America sales fell 3.4% due to softer U.S. retail demand, while Emerging Markets surged 13.8%. The company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $2.07-$2.13 per share, though it maintains expectations for operating income to decline 16-18% for the full year.

items.title: Martin Marietta Q3 Earnings Beat on Acquisitions, Revenue Outlook Up
items.summary: Martin Marietta Materials (MLM) exceeded Q3 earnings expectations with adjusted EPS of $5.47 vs. consensus of $5.27, driven by strong acquisition contributions and record aggregates shipments up 15.9%. The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $7.75-$7.85 billion, though margins contracted due to higher energy costs and acquisition-related pricing pressures. Despite the beat, MLM stock declined 4.2% pre-market as investors weighed margin compression against growth prospects.

items.title: Global AI Accelerator Market - 2026 Edition: Size, Share, Trends, and Forecast to 2030 | Market to Reach US$443 Billion as Generative AI and Edge Inference Scale
items.summary: The global AI accelerator market is valued at US$151.0B in 2025 and is forecast to reach US$443.0B by 2030, representing a 24% CAGR. Growth is driven by generative AI adoption, large language model deployment, and hyperscaler investments. North America leads with 48% market share, while Asia Pacific is the fastest-growing region at 30.4% CAGR. GPUs dominate with 58% market share, while NPUs are expected to grow fastest at 32% CAGR. Data-center accelerators lead at 55% share, with edge accelerators growing at 29% CAGR.

items.title: Better AI Semiconductor Monopoly Stock: Taiwan Semiconductor vs. ASML
items.summary: ASML and TSMC dominate their respective semiconductor niches and are well-positioned to benefit from the booming AI chip demand. ASML, the sole manufacturer of advanced EUV lithography machines, is experiencing faster growth with 55% revenue increase and 133% net income growth. TSMC, the world's largest foundry with 73% market share, is growing at a solid 41% revenue pace. Both stocks are recommended, though ASML offers higher growth while TSMC provides a better value-growth mix.

items.title: 2 Berkshire Hathaway Holdings to Buy After Record Third Quarters
items.summary: The article highlights two Berkshire Hathaway portfolio holdings with strong third-quarter performance: Chubb, a property and casualty insurer, reported record net income and core operating income with a healthy 84% combined ratio despite increased catastrophic losses; American Express posted record revenue of $20.1 billion with 31% EPS growth year-over-year, though it missed consensus estimates due to exiting some co-branded partnerships and announced a 5% workforce reduction to leverage AI capabilities.

items.title: Datadog Guides Q4 Sales Flat After 35% Growth: Rapid Earnings Reaction
items.summary: Datadog reported strong Q3 revenue growth of 35% to $1.2 billion and achieved GAAP operating profitability, but shares fell 12% in pre-market trading after the company guided Q4 revenue to remain flat compared to Q3. The flat outlook suggests slowing usage growth, and adjusted operating margins are expected to decline, while free cash flow growth lagged revenue growth at only 17%.

items.title: OUST Q3 Earnings Call Highlights REV8 Demand and Robotics Growth
items.summary: Ouster (OUST) reported Q3 2026 earnings that beat estimates with a 20-cent loss per share versus 30-cent consensus, and revenues of $59.3 million exceeding $56.2 million guidance. The company highlighted strong demand for its REV8 lidar sensors, plans to expand annual manufacturing capacity beyond 100,000 units by end of 2027, and momentum in Stereolabs cameras. Q4 guidance projects $61-64 million in revenues with approximately 48% year-over-year growth expected for 2026.

items.title: UPST Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Macro Risks and Revised Outlook
items.summary: Upstart Holdings exceeded Q3 earnings and revenue estimates with strong fee revenue growth of 41% and record contribution profit. However, the company lowered its 2026 revenue guidance to $1.35 billion from $1.4 billion due to deteriorating consumer credit conditions and higher funding costs. The company's secured lending business turned profitable with a 17% contribution margin, and management plans to launch Upstart Bank in early 2027 with $404.1 million in capital.

items.title: SMCI Q1 Earnings Beat on Large AI Deployments, Outlook Raised
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) reported exceptional Q1 fiscal 2027 results with EPS surging 417.1% to $1.81 and revenues jumping 297.5% year-over-year to $19.95 billion, driven by large AI data center projects accounting for 71% of sales. The company raised its full-year revenue guidance to $72-$82 billion. However, customer concentration remains elevated with one customer representing 44% of quarterly revenues, and the company faces constraints from component shortages and power availability.

items.title: MPC Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Refining Strength and Asset Sales
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) delivered strong third-quarter 2026 results with adjusted earnings of $26.93 per share exceeding estimates by 4.60% and revenues of $56.487 billion surpassing consensus by 68.30%. The company achieved 100% refinery utilization with 3.2 million barrels per day throughput, supported by elevated refining margins. MPC announced a $4.2 billion divestiture of St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy, with proceeds to be reinvested in Gulf Coast operations. The company returned $3.284 billion to shareholders and increased its quarterly dividend by 10%, while maintaining a constructive refining outlook through mid-2027.

items.title: AIZ Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Lifestyle and Housing Strength
items.summary: Assurant (AIZ) reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $6.15 per share, significantly beating consensus estimates of $4.57. Revenue grew 9.2% to $3.55 billion, driven by strong performance in Global Lifestyle and Global Housing segments. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to approximately 10% growth and expects low-double-digit adjusted earnings per share growth. Other multi-line insurers showed mixed results, with Everest Group missing estimates while Prudential Financial beat expectations.

items.title: SHOP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Commerce and Margin Discipline
items.summary: Shopify reported Q3 2026 earnings beating consensus estimates with $3.74B in revenue and $0.49 EPS. The company highlighted AI-driven commerce growth with AI-referred traffic up 2.6X and orders up 3.3X. Q4 revenue is expected to grow in the low 30s percentage range. Free cash flow reached $816M at a 22% margin, with payments penetration exceeding 68%. Sidekick AI assistant usage surged while costs declined 18%, and the company expanded into offline retail, B2B, and international markets.

items.title: ZBRA Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Strong Demand and Raised Outlook
items.summary: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) raised its 2026 sales growth outlook to 17% following strong third-quarter earnings, with Q3 EPS of $4.95 beating estimates and sales of $1.61B exceeding expectations. The company reported broad-based demand across retail, transportation, logistics, manufacturing, and healthcare sectors, with Connected Frontline posting 15% organic growth. However, rising memory costs pressured gross margins, declining 220 basis points to 46%. Management expects 2027 growth to approach the upper end of its long-term 5-7% range, supported by a multiyear transportation and logistics device refresh pipeline.

items.title: XYZ Q3 Earnings Call Highlights 2027 Outlook and AI Expansion
items.summary: Block, Inc. (XYZ) exceeded Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates with adjusted EPS up 109% and gross profit rising 22%. The company raised its 2026 outlook and provided 2027 targets, projecting 15% gross profit growth and 30% adjusted operating income growth with a 32% margin. Square's GPV grew 14%, Cash App lending surged 40%, and Block expects initial AI revenues in Q4 2026.

items.title: WMB Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Power Backlog and Funding
items.summary: The Williams Companies reported Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $2.039B (up 6%), maintaining 2026 guidance of $8.3B-$8.5B. Management expects one or two more power deals by year-end with longer contracts and phased expansions. Year-end leverage projected near 3.75X with ~$2B financial capacity remaining under its 4X ceiling. The company emphasized execution on pipelines, storage, and power projects while managing expansion and balance sheet growth.

items.title: ServiceNow Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Outlook Risks
items.summary: ServiceNow lifted its 2026 AI ACV target to $1.7B as AI contract value surged 65% year-over-year, with AI deals exceeding $1M growing 4.5x. The company raised 2026 subscription revenue guidance to $15.785B and increased free cash flow margin targets. However, slower-than-expected Q4 cRPO growth of 18.5% and bundled deployment services impacting subscription revenue recognition raised investor concerns about future acceleration.

items.title: GOOGL Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Spending Pressures
items.summary: Alphabet reported Q3 earnings of $2.12 per share, missing consensus estimates of $2.94, with revenues of $111.21 billion below the $111.8 billion estimate. Google Cloud revenues surged 103% to $30.7 billion driven by enterprise AI demand, while the company reaffirmed $195-205 billion in 2026 capex guidance. Q3 capital expenditures of $51.4 billion resulted in negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion, reflecting heavy infrastructure investments and TPU inventory accumulation.

items.title: GEHC Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Raised Outlook and Margin Risks
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $4.95-$5.05 and expects ~4% organic revenue growth, driven by strong Q3 performance and productivity improvements. The company's diagnostics segment grew 13.8% while Patient Care Solutions grew 8.8%. However, tariff exposure and fourth-quarter comparisons pose risks to near-term growth.

items.title: FTNT Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Services Outlook and AI Demand
items.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $8.125-$8.215 billion and billings guidance to $9.568-$9.718 billion, driven by strong enterprise demand, AI security initiatives, and large deployments. However, the company faces headwinds from delayed service revenue recognition, component cost pressures, and questions about sustainability of hardware demand in 2027.

items.title: FORM Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Capacity Expansion and AI Demand
items.summary: FormFactor (FORM) announced plans to expand manufacturing capacity at its Farmers Branch facility to $400M in annual probe card revenue by end-2027. The company raised its 2026 TRITON photonics system revenue outlook to over $30M, reported strong Q3 results with 10% sequential growth in Foundry and Logic revenues, and expects sustained margin improvements around 53% baseline. Systems revenues hit a record $59.5M with 23% sequential growth.

items.title: FANG Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Capital Discipline and Permian Growth
items.summary: Diamondback Energy (FANG) reported strong Q3 2026 earnings, beating consensus estimates with adjusted EPS of $5.86 and revenues of $5.43 billion. The company raised its 2026 oil production guidance to 524,000 barrels per day while maintaining capital discipline with a ~30% reinvestment rate. Management highlighted Barnett formation development with target well costs of $850-$900 per lateral foot, explored enhanced oil recovery technology, and secured pipeline access for natural gas opportunities. The company generated $2.15 billion in adjusted free cash flow during the quarter.

items.title: CAT Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Record Backlog and Capacity Push
items.summary: Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) reported a record $78 billion backlog, up 96% year-over-year, driven by strong demand in power generation (data centers, AI infrastructure), construction, and mining. The company maintains mid-to-high-teens 2026 revenue growth outlook and plans to triple large engine capacity by 2030. However, management acknowledged $2.2 billion in projected tariff costs and manufacturing capacity constraints. Q3 adjusted earnings of $7.2 per share and revenues of $20.68 billion both exceeded consensus estimates.

items.title: BKNG Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Travel Slowdown and AI Push
items.summary: Booking Holdings (BKNG) reported Q3 earnings with AI-powered services showing strong conversion improvements, but management issued a cautious Q4 outlook citing moderating international travel demand and Middle East disruptions. The company expects Q4 room night growth of 1-3% and adjusted revenue growth of 0-2%, while maintaining 2026 full-year guidance for high-single-digit growth. BKNG is investing heavily in AI initiatives, loyalty programs through Connected Trips, and targeting $650M in annual savings by 2027.

items.title: Arista Networks Q3 Earnings Call Maps Out 2027 AI Expansion
items.summary: Arista Networks raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $13.3B (48% growth) with Q3 revenues reaching $3.66B, beating estimates. The company projects 2027 revenues of $18.5B with AI fabrics doubling to $7B and cognitive campus reaching $2B. Management addressed supply constraints through $11.4B in purchase commitments and emphasized enterprise adoption across healthcare, hospitality, and web services sectors.

items.title: AMGN Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Pipeline and Raised Outlook
items.summary: Amgen reported strong Q3 earnings with adjusted EPS of $6.45 beating estimates and raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $38.9B-$39.7B and EPS outlook to $22.90-$23.70. The company highlighted growth from key medicines like IMDELLTRA, MariTide, and TEZSPIRE, though biosimilar competition pressured mature products like Prolia and XGEVA. Management emphasized late-stage clinical progress and manufacturing readiness as foundations for future growth.

items.title: SMCI Q1 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Margin Pressures
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) raised its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $72B-$82B, driven by accelerating AI infrastructure demand and stronger customer commitments. The company reported record Q1 revenues of $19.95B and adjusted EPS of $1.81, exceeding consensus estimates. However, SMCI faces margin pressures from large AI deployments, component shortages, and significant customer concentration, with one customer representing 44% of revenues.

items.title: NVTS Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Infrastructure Growth
items.summary: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) reported Q3 2026 earnings and revenue beats with 38% year-over-year sales growth to $14 million. The company expects AI infrastructure to contribute over 40% of Q4 revenues and potentially triple in 2027, with double-digit sequential revenue growth possible throughout the year. Management highlighted a book-to-bill ratio of 2, backlog extending into mid-2027, and multiple 800-volt power conversion opportunities. The Claros acquisition expands the company's integrated voltage regulation capabilities for AI processors.

items.title: FLEX Q2 Earnings Call Highlights Axiom Spin-Off and AI Growth
items.summary: Flex Ltd. reported strong Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings, beating consensus estimates with adjusted EPS of $1.18 and revenues of $8.49 billion. The company raised full-year guidance to $34.9-$35.9 billion in revenue and $4.84-$5.16 in adjusted EPS, driven by accelerating AI infrastructure demand and the planned spin-off of its Cloud and Power Infrastructure (CPI) business as Axiom. CPI revenues surged 54% year-over-year to $2.5 billion with expanding margins, while management projects 75-85% CPI growth in fiscal 2027.

items.title: AMD Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and 2027 Growth Outlook
items.summary: AMD raised its 2027 growth expectations to over 80%, with data centers expected to contribute more than 80% of revenues. Q3 data center revenues surged 97% to $8.5B, driven by record EPYC processor and Instinct accelerator sales. However, the company faces supply constraints amid rising AI orders and expects double-digit PC market declines in 2027.

items.title: ADM Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Biofuels Strength and 2027 Outlook
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland Company (ADM) raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.50-$5.80 for the third time this year, driven by strong North American biofuels margins and improved operational execution. The company's Ag Services and Oilseeds segment saw profit surge 105% to $778M on stronger soybean crushing and biodiesel margins. ADM also increased its 45Z incentive benefit forecast to $350M and reduced planned 2026 capital spending to $1.2-$1.3B, while maintaining a constructive but measured outlook for 2027.

items.title: BSX Q3 Results Reset Growth Expectations as 2027 Outlook Stays Weak
items.summary: Boston Scientific reported Q3 organic sales growth of 1.5%, missing its 3%-5% guidance due to an August cybersecurity disruption that impacted manufacturing and shipments. The company cut its full-year 2026 organic sales growth forecast to 3.75% from 5%-6% and reduced adjusted EPS guidance to $3.16-$3.18. Management expects 2027 to be the cycle's trough, with recovery anticipated in 2028 driven by new product launches. The company faces ongoing competitive pressure in electrophysiology and WATCHMAN sales weakness.

items.title: Pfizer: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Pfizer raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $62-64 billion, driven by strong performance from launched and acquired products with 32% operational revenue growth in Q3. The company is implementing $7.2 billion in cost-saving initiatives to offset upcoming patent expirations on key drugs. Management projects high single-digit revenue growth from 2028-2033, contingent on successfully converting late-stage oncology and obesity treatment trials into commercial revenue.

items.title: Diamondback Q3 Earnings Beat on Higher Oil Prices and Production
items.summary: Diamondback Energy (FANG) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $5.86, beating estimates by 19.1%, with revenues surging 38.4% year-over-year to $5.43 billion. The company generated $2.15 billion in free cash flow, raised its 2026 production guidance, increased its dividend by 7.3%, and repurchased $251 million in shares. Higher oil prices and 9.7% production growth drove strong results.

items.title: Cerebras Systems vs. Innodata: Which Tech Stock Is the Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares two AI infrastructure companies: Cerebras Systems, a hardware manufacturer with 91% revenue growth but $512M net losses and negative cash flow, versus Innodata, a data engineering specialist with 39% revenue growth, $47M net income, and $184M free cash flow. The author recommends Innodata for 2027 due to profitability, cheaper valuation metrics, and expected 22% annualized earnings growth, while suggesting waiting on Cerebras until it demonstrates sustainable cash flow.

items.title: Seagate Revenue Soars 61% in Q1: Can This Momentum Continue?
items.summary: Seagate Technology (STX) delivered robust Q1 fiscal 2027 results with revenues surging 61% to $4.2B and non-GAAP EPS jumping 194% to $7.68, driven by strong data center demand and record capacity shipments. The company projects Q2 revenues of $4.8B with continued growth expected from HAMR technology adoption and favorable pricing. Competitors Western Digital and NetApp also reported strong performance in AI-driven storage demand.

items.title: MOS Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Higher Costs, Lower Volumes
items.summary: The Mosaic Company (MOS) reported a Q3 2026 net loss of 23 cents per share, wider than consensus estimates, as net sales declined 10.2% year-over-year to $3.1 billion. Lower sales volumes across all segments and higher raw material costs pressured results, though the company beat revenue expectations. MOS expects continued cost pressures in Q4 2026 and revised full-year potash production guidance downward to 8.6 million tons due to lower ore grades.

items.title: CME vs. Nu: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: CME Group and Nu Holdings represent different investment profiles in the financial sector. CME offers stability with a 62% net margin and fortress balance sheet but modest 6.4% revenue growth, while Nu demonstrates aggressive 43% revenue growth in digital banking across Latin America with an 18.1% net margin. However, the author recommends sitting out this comparison, noting both stocks have underperformed the S&P 500 over the past five years.

items.title: Gartner: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Gartner raised its full-year revenue guidance to at least $6.405 billion following strong Q3 2026 results. The company demonstrated resilience through accelerating contract value growth ($5.3 billion), aggressive share buybacks ($1.7 billion over four quarters reducing share count by ~15%), and improved client retention driven by enterprise AI demand and internal business transformation initiatives.

items.title: Andy Jassy Just Delivered Magnificent News for Amazon Investors
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) reported record $45.9 billion in Q3 revenue with 39% year-over-year growth, marking six consecutive quarters of accelerating growth. CEO Andy Jassy forecasted AWS could grow revenue by over 40% in 2027-2028 and become a trillion-dollar revenue business within 5-10 years, driven by expanding AI services and custom chip adoption. Despite a 15% stock correction, Amazon trades at a P/E of 19.4, significantly below the Nasdaq-100's 29.9, presenting a potential buying opportunity.

items.title: Bloom Energy's New Guidance Implies Up to $1.55 Billion in Q4 Revenue. Can It Deliver?
items.summary: Bloom Energy raised its Q4 revenue guidance to $1.35-$1.55 billion, driven by surging demand from AI data centers needing rapid power solutions. The company is expanding manufacturing capacity toward a 5+ GW annual goal and management believes it won't be a bottleneck for hardware assembly, positioning it to capitalize on the power grid interconnection bottleneck.

items.title: Broadcom vs. Taiwan Semiconductor: Two AI Powerhouses, but One Offers a Better Value for 2027
items.summary: Both Broadcom and Taiwan Semiconductor are major beneficiaries of the AI boom, but Taiwan Semiconductor offers better value for 2027 investors. While Broadcom generated $63.9B in revenue with strong AI chip growth, Taiwan Semiconductor delivered superior financial performance with $122.4B in revenue, 45.1% profit margins, and lower valuation multiples (24.2x forward P/E vs. 27.9x for Broadcom). Taiwan Semiconductor's stronger growth, higher margins, and more attractive valuation make it the more compelling investment despite geopolitical risks.

items.title: Amazon vs. Target: One Is Riding the AI Boom, While the Other Faces a Consumer Spending Squeeze
items.summary: Amazon and Target show diverging growth trajectories. Amazon maintains double-digit revenue growth fueled by e-commerce, AWS cloud computing (up 39%), advertising, and AI infrastructure demand, reaching $201.9B in Q3 2026 revenue. Target struggles with weaker discretionary consumer spending, showing modest 5.3% sales growth and flat revenue trends, though recent stabilization and digital growth offer some encouragement. Amazon's diversified business model positions it as a more attractive investment than Target's uncertain retail turnaround.

items.title: Coca-Cola vs. PepsiCo: Pepsi's Revenue Dwarfs Coke's, but This Is the Number to Watch
items.summary: While PepsiCo's revenue nearly doubles Coca-Cola's, Coca-Cola's steadier quarterly growth and superior operating margins (33.4% vs 16.9%) signal stronger pricing power and a more efficient business model. Recent account losses to Coca-Cola, including KFC's $500M switch and Marriott's beverage provider change, have pressured PepsiCo's outlook, while Coca-Cola stock has surged 40% in 2026.

items.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Apple and Palantir Technologies
items.summary: Apple and Palantir Technologies both retreated roughly 2% on Tuesday despite delivering impressive quarterly results. Apple reported record Q4 and FY26 results with strong iPhone and Services revenue growth, while Palantir showed explosive AI-driven growth with 96% revenue increase. Both stocks received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, with Apple offering better stability through reasonable valuation and exceptional free cash flow, while Palantir presents greater growth potential but trades at a lofty valuation.

items.title: L3Harris: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: L3Harris reported strong Q3 2026 results with 9% organic revenue growth and a record $53 billion backlog, driven by $11 billion in missile program contracts. The company is leveraging automation and AI to accelerate production while shifting focus from acquisitions to internal execution and debt reduction, positioning itself well for sustained defense spending.

items.title: Realty Income: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Realty Income raised its 2026 AFFO guidance to $4.45-$4.46 per share while maintaining its $10 billion annual investment target. The company is diversifying its strategy through European real estate investments (7.1% yield), credit investments in high-rate environments, and alternative capital sources to reduce reliance on public equity issuance. This multi-pronged approach allows the company to preserve investment spreads and drive sustainable per-share growth.

items.title: Nokia vs. AT&T: Comparing Cyclical Sales Patterns vs. Steady Revenue
items.summary: AT&T generates roughly five times more revenue than Nokia with consistent quarter-over-quarter performance, while Nokia exhibits cyclical patterns with sharp Q4 spikes reflecting IT budget spending cycles. Both companies show year-over-year growth, but Nokia's AI and cloud business is accelerating with 123% growth, potentially transforming its revenue trajectory. AT&T's steady free cash flow supports its dividend payments, demonstrating reliable operational performance.

items.title: The Ensign Group, Inc. Notice of December 7, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against The Ensign Group, Inc. for investors who purchased shares between February 10, 2022 and June 18, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Ensign made materially false statements and failed to disclose systematic neglect of elderly residents, abuse, Medicaid/Medicare fraud, falsification of nursing assistant hours, and illegal licensing schemes. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 7, 2026.

items.title: Everest Group, Ltd. Notice of December 28, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announces a class action securities lawsuit against Everest Group, Ltd. for investors who purchased stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025. The lawsuit alleges that Everest made materially false statements about its Insurance division's casualty reserves. In October 2025, the company disclosed $478 million in unfavorable prior year reserve development and secured $1.2 billion in protection against further adverse development. The stock price fell 11.4% following the disclosure. The application deadline to request lead plaintiff status is December 28, 2026.

items.title: Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. Notice of November 23, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
items.summary: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC announced multiple class action securities lawsuits against publicly traded companies. Honeywell Aerospace faces allegations of failing to disclose supplier concentration risks, supply constraints, cybersecurity investigation, and making misleading statements about business prospects. The Ensign Group and Duolingo also have pending securities fraud lawsuits with application deadlines in December 2026.

items.title: Nike vs. Procter & Gamble: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares Nike and Procter & Gamble as investment options for 2027. Nike trades at a premium valuation (32.2x forward P/E) despite slowing revenue growth, though it offers an attractive 4.19% dividend yield and is on track to become a Dividend King. Procter & Gamble offers more defensive positioning with essential household goods, a lower valuation (23.2x forward P/E), and is already a Dividend King with 70 consecutive years of dividend increases. The author recommends P&G over Nike, citing P&G's superior 2026 performance (+14.1% vs Nike's -38.6%) and more stable business model.

items.title: BigBear.ai vs. Nebius: Which AI Stock Is the Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: The article compares two AI stocks: BigBear.ai, which provides defense-focused decision-intelligence software but faces declining revenue and significant losses, versus Nebius, a cloud infrastructure company experiencing explosive 444% revenue growth and recent profitability. The author recommends Nebius for 2027 despite its high valuation multiples and recent 38% stock decline, citing its scarce, high-demand infrastructure assets and strong earnings trajectory.

items.title: Sysco: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Sysco reported Q1 FY2027 earnings with adjusted EPS of $1.19 and announced three key initiatives: an AI transformation program targeting $100 million in cost savings for FY2027 and $500 million by FY2029, the pending acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot expected to close by Q3 FY2027, and local case volume growth of 2.7% despite a 2% decline in broader restaurant industry traffic. The company is leveraging technology and strategic acquisitions to drive margin expansion in the second half of the year.

items.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Bank of America Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BAC
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation for allegedly failing to disclose systemic weaknesses in its Bank of America, N.A. subsidiary's BSA/AML compliance program, which caused it to improperly monitor trillions in transactions and file inaccurate suspicious activity reports. The lawsuit also alleges deficiencies in sanctions compliance programs. Investors who purchased BAC stock between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a December 15, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

items.title: AMD EPS: Intel's Drag Makes No Sense
items.summary: Intel's stock plunged 28% after reporting strong earnings but disappointing guidance of $15-16B versus Wall Street's $17.1B estimate. The decline stems from a severe PC market downturn, with expected unit shipments dropping 12% in 2026 and 10% in 2027. In contrast, AMD is thriving with 74% revenue growth and shifting toward an AI-first company, with data center expected to account for over 80% of revenue by 2027. Intel's supply-demand imbalance in the expanding server CPU market presents an opportunity for AMD to gain market share.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Honeywell Aerospace Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – HONA
items.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Honeywell Aerospace Inc. and Fluence Energy, Inc., alleging securities fraud and unlawful business practices. Honeywell Aerospace experienced significant stock declines following disappointing Q2 2026 earnings (70% net income drop) and guidance cuts, followed by a $2 million DOJ settlement for cybersecurity compliance failures on a defense contract.

items.title: Pomerantz Law Firm Announces the Filing of a Class Action Against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and Certain Officers – ASTS
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and certain officers for alleged violations of federal securities laws. The complaint alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's competitive position in the satellite direct-to-cellular market, capital sufficiency, and user adoption rates, particularly following SpaceX's entry into the market through the EchoStar transaction. The class period spans March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026.

items.title: APPLOVIN DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important November 16 Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased APP securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 16, 2026.

items.title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Skyworks Solutions reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.28 per share, slightly beating consensus estimates of $1.27, with revenues of $1.05 billion. However, the company faces a mixed earnings outlook and operates in an industry ranked in the bottom 12% of Zacks industries. The stock received a Hold rating and is expected to perform in line with the market.

items.title: QuidelOrtho (QDEL) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: QuidelOrtho reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.31 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.18 by 72%, though revenues slightly missed expectations at $618.9M. Despite the earnings beat, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The stock has underperformed the market by 50.9% year-to-date, and the Medical-Products industry ranks in the bottom 35% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Prudential (PRU) Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates
items.summary: Prudential reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.77 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.31 by 13.90%, but revenues of $13.49 billion missed expectations by 3.35%. Despite the earnings beat, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, gaining 4.8% versus the market's 10.2% gain.

items.title: Duolingo, Inc. (DUOL) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: Duolingo reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.54 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $0.55, though revenues of $309.01 million exceeded expectations by 1.43%. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 33.1% year-to-date and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

items.title: Leidos' Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss, '26 EPS View Raised
items.summary: Leidos Holdings reported Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $3.62, beating estimates by 19.1%, but revenues of $4.63B missed forecasts. The company raised 2026 EPS guidance to $12.50-$12.70 and operating cash flow to $1.9B, though it cut revenue outlook to $18.00-$18.20B. Homeland segment revenues surged 32.1% while Health segment declined 11.7%. The company maintains a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026, AppLovin made false and misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased AppLovin securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

items.title: Amazon's Earnings Just Hit a Record. So Why Is the Stock Down 11% From Its Peak?
items.summary: Amazon reported record earnings with AWS revenue up 39% to $46 billion and strong e-commerce margins, but the stock fell 11% from its peak due to investor concerns about negative free cash flow from $220 billion in AI capital expenditures and slowing North American e-commerce growth. However, the e-commerce slowdown was largely due to a Prime Day scheduling shift, and the company's long-term growth prospects remain strong with potential for significant earnings expansion.

items.title: Palantir Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Sovereign AI Demand and Outlook
items.summary: Palantir Technologies raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $8.53B, representing 91% year-over-year growth, driven by accelerating enterprise adoption of sovereign AI. U.S. commercial revenue surged 148% to $984M, surpassing government revenues for the first time. The company reported Q3 adjusted earnings of $0.44 per share and a 62% operating margin, with strong demand for AI-driven operational workflows and defense deployments.

items.title: Healthpeak's Q3 FFOA Beat Estimates on Leasing, Senior Housing Growth
items.summary: Healthpeak Properties (DOC) reported Q3 2026 FFOA of $0.44 per share, beating estimates by 2.3%, with revenues up 16.3% YoY to $820.9 million. The company raised 2026 FFOA guidance to $1.76-$1.78 per share, supported by solid outpatient leasing, improving lab occupancy, and strong senior housing performance from Janus Living. However, operating expenses surged 30% YoY, and the company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: Vertex Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Revenue Beat and Pipeline Expansion
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals reported Q3 2026 revenues of $3.44 billion, beating estimates by 1.2% with 12% year-over-year growth driven by its CF franchise and newer therapies like CASGEVY and JOURNAVX. However, earnings missed consensus at $4.76 per share due to higher operating expenses and acquisition costs from the Crinetics Pharmaceuticals deal. The company raised full-year revenue guidance to $13.15-$13.25 billion and highlighted an upcoming FDA decision on povetacicept for kidney disease on November 30, 2026.

items.title: Realty Income Has Paid 676 Consecutive Monthly Dividends. Here’s How Its Earnings Results Fit the Bigger Picture.
items.summary: Realty Income reported Q3 2026 earnings with AFFO up 3.7% to $1.12 per share and raised full-year guidance to $4.45-$4.46. The REIT maintains a 73% dividend payout ratio, invested $2.6 billion in the quarter at 6.8% yield, and continues its 56-year streak of consecutive monthly dividends supported by a diversified tenant base and 96%+ occupancy rates.

items.title: Pinnacle West Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Sales Growth
items.summary: Pinnacle West Capital (PNW) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.49 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.40, with revenues rising 8.3% to $1.97 billion. Operating income grew 6.7% driven by higher electricity sales, favorable weather, and customer growth. The company maintains 2026 EPS guidance of $5.05-$5.25 and projects 8-10% weather-normalized retail sales growth.

items.title: SBAC Q3 FFO Top Estimates on International Leasing Gains
items.summary: SBA Communications (SBAC) reported Q3 FFO of $3.19 per share, beating estimates by 3.6%, though down 3.3% year-over-year. International site-leasing revenues grew 13.3%, but domestic leasing declined 3.4% due to Sprint and EchoStar churn. The company lowered 2026 revenue guidance but raised AFFO per-share guidance midpoint by 8 cents. SBAC carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.title: Valero to Acquire Houston Refining Site, Plans 165,000 BPD Restart
items.summary: Valero Energy has agreed to acquire a 100% equity stake in LYB Houston Hub Holdings LLC from LyondellBasell Industries for $320.5 million. The acquisition includes a 700-acre facility adjacent to Valero's existing Houston refinery, with plans to restart 165,000 barrels per day of light sweet crude processing capacity by late 2027. The deal also provides Valero with options to invest in heavy sour crude processing infrastructure, leveraging its existing expertise in processing discounted heavy crude grades.

items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Q3 Earnings Beat on Beverage Growth, Sales Miss
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of 66 cents, beating estimates, with net sales of $7.3 billion missing expectations. The company's U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment grew 10.9% while U.S. Coffee operating income advanced 11.4%, supported by the JDE Peet's acquisition. KDP reaffirmed 2026 sales guidance of $25.9-$26.4 billion but narrowed legacy EPS growth expectations to 3-5%.

items.title: CoreWeave's 15% Bond Yield Is a Warning for AI Debt. Here Are the Stocks Most Exposed.
items.summary: CoreWeave, a rapidly growing AI infrastructure provider, is raising red flags with its 15% bond yields and high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of 14.3), despite strong revenue growth. The company spends a quarter of its revenue on interest payments and faces potential refinancing challenges if rates continue rising. While competitors like Nebius and IREN have lower leverage, CoreWeave's financial stress could impact the broader neocloud sector's ability to secure affordable financing.

items.title: Netflix Trades at a Discount to the S&P 500's Valuation. Is It Deserved?
items.summary: Netflix stock has fallen 54% from its all-time high, now trading at a discount to the S&P 500 for the first time in its history. The decline is driven by slowing revenue growth and disappointing guidance. However, the author argues the discount is unwarranted, citing Netflix's strong historical recovery patterns and attractive forward valuations of 14-12x earnings for 2028-2029.

items.title: Costco Hasn't Split Its Stock Since 2000. Here's Why 2027 Could Be the Year.
items.summary: With Costco's stock trading above $1,000 per share for the first time since its last split in 2000, a potential stock split in 2027 could make the stock more accessible to retail investors. While a split wouldn't change the company's underlying valuation, Costco's strong fundamentals—including its membership model, consistent earnings growth, and international expansion opportunities—make it an attractive long-term holding regardless of share price.

items.title: Aptiv Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates Amid Non-Auto Growth
items.summary: Aptiv (APTV) beat Q3 earnings expectations with $1.42 EPS and $3.20B in revenues, driven by strong Engineered Components growth. However, the company faces margin pressures from commodity costs and material inflation, leading to reduced free cash flow guidance for 2026. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating, having declined 45.3% over the past year.

items.title: Devon Energy to Report Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Devon Energy (DVN) is set to report Q3 2026 earnings on November 5 with consensus estimates of $1.24 per share and $7.33B in revenues. The company is expected to beat estimates due to strong Delaware Basin production, full-quarter contributions from the Coterra merger, operational efficiencies, and over 350 identified synergy initiatives. DVN trades at a discount valuation of 8.98X forward earnings versus the industry average of 10.75X, with a strong balance sheet featuring only 21.43% debt-to-capital ratio.

items.title: RVTY Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Life Sciences Strength, '26 View Up
items.summary: Revvity (RVTY) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.38, beating estimates by 7%, with revenues rising 4.3% to $728.9M. Life Sciences revenues climbed 10.7% driven by strong pharma and biotech demand. The company raised its 2026 pro forma EPS guidance to $5.40-$5.45 and revenue forecast to $2.86B, reflecting 6% total growth and 5% organic growth.

items.title: What Makes Altria (MO) a Strong Momentum Stock: Buy Now?
items.summary: Altria (MO) has earned a Zacks Momentum Style Score of A and a #2 (Buy) rating, driven by strong short-term and long-term price performance that outpaces both its industry and the broader market. Recent earnings estimate revisions have been positive, with upward movements in both current and next fiscal year estimates, supporting the bullish outlook for the tobacco company.

items.title: Eaton Q3 Earnings Top Estimates on Strong Organic Sales, View Up
items.summary: Eaton Corporation (ETN) delivered robust third-quarter results with adjusted EPS of $3.68 (up 19.9%) and revenues of $8.95 billion (up 28%), driven by strong electrical demand and a 65% surge in data center revenues. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $13.70-$13.80 and organic growth guidance to 13-15%, while achieving record segment operating margins of 25.3%. The company also announced plans to acquire COL Group for $921 million and separate its Mobility business in 2027.

items.title: MARUY or HON: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
items.summary: A comparison of two Diversified Operations sector stocks reveals that Marubeni Corp. (MARUY) presents a better value opportunity than Honeywell International Inc. (HON). MARUY has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with improving earnings outlook, a lower forward P/E ratio of 12.23 versus HON's 26.52, and a Value grade of A compared to HON's C grade.

items.title: Archer Daniels Q3 Earnings Beat on Biofuel Strength, Revenues Miss
items.summary: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.77, up 92.4% YoY and beating consensus estimates by 8.6%, driven by strong biofuel margins and robust ethanol economics. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.50-$5.80 from $5.15-$5.60, citing favorable biofuel conditions and increased domestic demand. However, revenues of $22.34 billion missed forecasts slightly.

items.title: Can Quanta's Record Backlog Support Its 2027 Double-Digit EPS Growth?
items.summary: Quanta Services (PWR) reported a record backlog of $63.73 billion, up 62.7% year-over-year, with third-quarter adjusted EPS jumping to $6.06. The company raised its 2026 EPS guidance and expects strong double-digit adjusted EPS growth in 2027, supported by workforce investments and rising power infrastructure demand. PWR stock has gained 47.2% YTD and currently trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 32.64.
